structured_sections.title: OFFICIAL VERIFICATION REPORT: Rainwater Harvesting Facility Installation
structured_sections.executive_summary:
The grant request submitted by Ms. Sunita Rao (AADHAAR-1122-3344-5566) on 2026-03-20 seeks financial assistance for the installation of a community rainwater harvesting facility under the Municipal Works Board. The application details a project to construct a rainwater recharge tank, with a requested amount of Rs. 3,75,000/- only, and is supported by all mandatory documentation, including identity proof, address proof, sanction order, and a community consent resolution.
The automated audit confirms complete field extraction, consistency of applicant information across all documents, alignment of the sanction reference (SANCTION-MWB-2026-881) with the request, and a plausible timeline. No contradictions or implausible dates were detected, resulting in an overall verdict of "valid".
